mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% over the past three months signals a tightening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in consumer price inflation signal an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0% and CPIAUCSL rises above 320.0 (as of t-3mo).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 320), an increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 320, FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month, but SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 1350 thousand units signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index) signals a weakening manufacturing sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past three months (FEDFUNDS rising by at least 0.5 percentage points) signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE falling by at least 0.2 percentage points in the past month) signals immediate labor market strength and positive economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points.
